chunks.text: Application information. Output capacitor: the regulator requires an output capacitor of at least 10 µF with an equivalent series resistance (ESR) between 0.3 Ω and 3 Ω for stability. Multilayer ceramic capacitors alone, or output capacitance below 10 µF, can cause sustained oscillation.
Input capacitor: a 1 µF or larger capacitor from VIN to GND, placed close to the device, is recommended. Layout: keep the output capacitor within 5 mm of the VOUT pin.
